h1: Best Western Plus Wanda Grand Nonthaburi — on the Pink Line and next to Central, with big 30 sqm rooms
intro: If you need to stay around Chaengwattana-Pak Kret — for government-office errands, the Government Complex, an event at Muang Thong Thani, or simply somewhere easy to get around from — Best Western Plus Wanda Grand Hotel is a name locals keep mentioning. It's a 4-star, 183-room business hotel about 280 m from the Pink Line Chaeng Watthana-Pak Kret 28 station, with a covered walk straight into CentralPlaza Chaengwattana. The modern rooms start at 30 sqm, there's an outdoor pool and a gym, and rates start at about ฿1,400/night. It scores 9.0 from real Trip.com reviews.

body.html: What gives Wanda Grand the edge over other places around Chaengwattana is the location. The hotel sits about 280 m from the Pink Line Chaeng Watthana-Pak Kret 28 station, with a covered link straight into CentralPlaza Chaengwattana so you barely step into the sun. From there the Pink Line runs on to the Government Complex and Muang Thong Thani, and connects to the Red and Green lines into central Bangkok. For anyone here for meetings, conferences or government-office business, it's a genuinely convenient base that spares you the Chaengwattana traffic.

All 183 rooms start at around 30 sqm, noticeably bigger than many hotels in the same class. They're done in a warm modern style with comfy beds, a work desk, a flat-screen TV, a fridge and a separate shower. Many are city-view rooms looking over Chaengwattana or the nearby golf course. The hotel opened in 2016, so rooms still feel current and well kept — cleanliness is something real reviews mention often.

"Bigger room than expected, comfy bed, you can walk straight into Central without going outside, and the Pink Line is right by the hotel — super convenient for getting government-office errands done."

Shared facilities include an outdoor swimming pool with a kids' pool, and a gym to unwind in after a long day. The Vanda restaurant serves Thai and international food all day, and there's a bar lounge for an evening drink. There are meeting rooms and a ballroom for conferences, airport transfers (Don Muang is about 11 km away) and free parking. Staff are the single most-praised thing in the reviews, with several guests naming front-desk team members who went well beyond their job.

To be straight about it, the most common complaint in the reviews is shower drainage and some upkeep details. A few reviews mention slow-draining showers, and some rooms have marks or spots that could use a refresh. It's a room-by-room thing rather than across the board, depending on the floor and the cleaning round. If your room doesn't feel right, ask the front desk to switch you straight away.

A couple more things to set expectations: breakfast can feel a bit limited on variety, and on busy mornings you may wait briefly for a table. As for the Chaengwattana location — handy as the train and mall are — the main road jams up at rush hour, so if you're driving, leave extra time morning and evening, or just use the Pink Line for a smoother run.

Overall, Best Western Plus Wanda Grand scores 9.0 out of 10 on Trip.com from around 959 real reviews and ranks among the top hotels in Pak Kret. It's a well-judged 4-star pick for workers and travellers who want a spot on the train line and next to a mall, with big rooms and a pool at a reachable price. Rates start around ฿1,400 and rise with the season and room type to about ฿1,900 for a standard room at peak. If you can live with the odd upkeep niggle and the Chaengwattana traffic, it's good value in this part of town.

A tip from the reviews: ask for a higher-floor city-view room for better light and more quiet than the lower floors. For Government Complex or Muang Thong Thani business, the Pink Line out front is far quicker than driving. And if you're booking around a big event at Muang Thong Thani, reserve early — rooms fill fast.

faqTitle: Frequently asked questions — Best Western Plus Wanda Grand Nonthaburi

faq.q: Where is Best Western Plus Wanda Grand, and how do you get there?
faq.a: The hotel is at 111 Moo 4, Chaengwattana Road, Khlong Kluea, Pak Kret, Nonthaburi. It's about 280 m from the Pink Line Chaeng Watthana-Pak Kret 28 station, with a covered walk into CentralPlaza Chaengwattana. Don Muang Airport is around 11 km away, and the Government Complex and Muang Thong Thani are close by.

faq.q: How much does Best Western Plus Wanda Grand cost, and what room types are there?
faq.a: Rates start at around ฿1,400/night for a Superior King or Superior Twin of 30 sqm. There are Family Rooms and Suites for families or longer stays. Prices rise with the season and when there's an event at Muang Thong Thani — always compare a few platforms before booking.

faq.q: Does Best Western Plus Wanda Grand have a pool and parking?
faq.a: Yes to both. There's an outdoor swimming pool with a kids' pool, a gym, and free parking. It also has the Vanda restaurant serving Thai and international food, a bar lounge, and airport transfer service.

faq.q: What are the rooms like at Best Western Plus Wanda Grand — are they clean?
faq.a: Rooms are modern and start at 30 sqm, bigger than same-class hotels, with comfy beds, and reviews generally praise the cleanliness. That said, some rooms get reports of slow shower drainage or spots that could use a refresh. Check the bathroom on arrival and ask to switch if it's not right.

faq.q: Who is Best Western Plus Wanda Grand best for?
faq.a: It's a great fit for workers and travellers who need to stay around Chaengwattana-Pak Kret for meetings, conferences, government-office business or a Muang Thong Thani event. Being on the Pink Line and next to Central makes it easy to get around, and it suits both short and longer stays.

faq.q: Is it easy to get into Bangkok from Best Western Plus Wanda Grand?
faq.a: Yes. The Pink Line out front connects to the Red Line and other lines into Bangkok. If you drive, Chaengwattana road jams up at rush hour, so leave extra time morning and evening — or just take the Pink Line for a smoother trip.
